name: Jindal Saw Ltd.
about: Jindal Saw Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of iron and steel pipes, and pellets in India and internationally. The company offers SAW pipes, such as double jointing, connector casings, hot pulled induction bends, monel sheating and anodes installation, post weld heat treatment, eddy current testing, and clad, as well as external and internal coatings, and line pipes; centrifugal casted pipes, including push up joint, double chamber restrained joint, and flanged pipes, as well as ductile iron fittings; and carbon/alloy steel seamless pipes and tubes comprising oil country tubular goods, flow line pipes, boiler pipes and tubes, and automotive tubes. It also provides stainless steel seamless and welded pipes and tubes, such as hydraulic and instrumentation tubing, condenser, heat exchanger, U-bends, coil tubing, and seamless pipes, as well as hollows and hollow bars; and welded

verdict.label: Around fair value
reasons: Price implies ~21% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~15% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 28 is near the top of its range over the last 3 years (median 12).
Trades at PE 28 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 48 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Profit fell 44% last year, which inflates PE; check whether the drop is cyclical (temporary) or structural.
